Brief description:
Estimates the value of π using the Monte Carlo simulation method with OpenMP parallelization. The number of iterations N is calculated as 256 × 256 × the command-line input. For each iteration, it generates a random point (x, y) in the unit square and checks if it lies inside the unit circle. Brief description:  
Implements the core rule set of Conway's Game of Life for a single cell at position `(i, j)` in a 2D grid represented as a 1D character array `c_m` of size `N x N`. The function counts the number of alive (`'X'`) and dead (`'.'`) neighboring cells around the target cell. It then applies the standard Game of Life rules:
- A live cell with fewer than 2 or more than 3 live neighbors dies.
- A live cell with 2 or 3 live neighbors survives.
- A dead cell with exactly 3 live neighbors becomes alive.
- In all other cases, the cell remains or becomes alive.
